brief: Design an interface for a "Dream Logic Navigator" where users compose abstract queries by dragging constellation points across a night sky canvas, with each star representing a concept that grows brig

dominant_strengths: Atmospheric dark gradient evokes a contemplative night-sky mood appropriate to the dream-logic premise
Restrained monospace HUD label hints at a technical/oracle hybrid voice without overwhelming the canvas
dominant_weaknesses: Stars read as inert gray dots with no luminosity, glow, or concept labels — failing the 'grows brighter' brief promise
Spatial layout is arbitrary scatter without constellation lines, hierarchy, or query-composition affordances
Zero visible interaction scaffolding: no drag handles, connection paths, query readout, or feedback for composition
fix_priorities: Add star luminosity states (dim/active/linked) with soft bloom to express concept weight
Render connection lines and a live query-string readout so dragging produces visible abstract syntax
Introduce concept labels on hover/proximity and a composition tray to anchor the navigator metaphor
Refine typography pairing and add subtle parallax/twinkle motion to lift visceral resonance
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral mood is mildly evocative but behavioral layer is nearly absent and reflective payoff stalls because the metaphor never resolves into usable meaning.
rationale.intent_fit: Only superficially fits the brief — it shows a starfield but omits the brightness, dragging, and query-composition mechanics that define the Dream Logic Navigator concept.
